title: Creating clothes for MetaHumans
author: denhopeEUW
selftext:
Hey everyone. I am vibecoding on my dream game and I am using the Unreal Engine 5. 

While the asset generation for my game works pretty okay for my game with Opus 5.5 and Blender, I have big problems to get proper clothing to my characters. 

  
I am using MetaHuman in my game (i dont know if this is the best solution) and want to add custom clothing. 

  
It costs me millions of tokens to generate clothing via Opus 5.5 and Blender to create clothes for my characters and they often look awful. 

  
Is there a way to optimize the workflow? Its a Sci-Fi Game where you most of the time play in space stations and spacecrafts from an isometric view so no high AAA graphics First person Game. 

  
I am very thankful for any advices!
